title: SWF: DefineShape4 tag (tag 83) fill and stroke styles
description: Test that a ShapeDisplayObject with fill produces DefineShape4 (tag 83) with correct FillStyleArray. Verify: (1) solid fill style type=0x00 with RGB color bytes, (2) no fill → no FillStyle record, (3) stroke (line style) with width and color encoded as UI16 thickness + RGB, (4) FillStyleCount > 0 for filled shapes, (5) ShapeHasNewStyles bit set for DefineShape4.
